Medical marijuana is legal in California. Kubby urges the Orange County Board of Supervisors to make the county’s law enforcement obey the state law. Not exactly a subversive idea. However, the OC Board of Supervisors sends his speech to the people who are prosecuting him. Why?)

O.C. SUPERVISORS SEND PLACER D.A. TAPE OF KUBBY SPEAKING

SANTA ANA -- After months of repeated requests by medical marijuana patients and supporters, the Orange County Supervisors have finally taken action.

That action was to turn over tape recordings of Steve Kubby addressing the Board of Supervisors to the Placer County District Attorney's Office – to be used as evidence in the upcoming medical marijuana trial of Steve and Michele Kubby.


Dale Wood, an attorney for Kubby, says he was shocked when he received, as part of the discovery process, tape recordings of Kubby addressing the Orange County Board of Supervisors. " This is out of control, " said Wood.

" The Orange County Supervisors have not only refused to uphold the rights of sick, disabled and dying patients, now they are party to persecuting those who lawfully attempt to assert their rights under the Compassionate Use Act, " complained Kubby.

Kubby, who serves as National Director for the American Medical Marijuana Associations, said his organization has filed carefully documented civil rights complaints with both the Orange County and Placer County Grand Juries to investigate the refusal of county officials to uphold the Compassionate Use Act.

" This is not the first time my first amendment rights have been violated by Placer County officials, " complained Kubby. " My speech last summer to a Libertarian convention in Kansas City was also tape recorded and entered as evidence against me. "

Kubby says he believes there is nothing incriminating in the tapes themselves, but they send a clear message: " Be careful what you say, we're watching you... "
